podcast.body: This cassette single, released in 1980, controversially left side B blank, a stunt that reportedly cost the band their record deal. The song itself is entirely about cassettes. `"Ba-Wa-Wa-Wa released a cassette single. Side B was left blank, and that stunt apparently cost them their record deal."`

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of Portable Music: Part 1

podcast.body: This single was released by the British group Bow Wow Wow at the start of the 1980s, intentionally encouraging home taping. Its title referenced common lengths of blank cassette tapes (30, 60, and 90 minutes), and one unique release format included the song on side one with side two left blank specifically for users to record their own content. "British Group released a single encouraging home taping called C30, C60, C90 Go."
